race.comment: MAIDOFF (5) is flying at the moment with a couple of big back-to-back wins at the Illawarra Grange circuit, the latest over 1300m under a 60kgs steadier. Up in class but drops to 58kgs. Can push forward from a middle draw and is going well enough to give this a mighty shake. TITANIUM MISS (3) made play last start over 1300m at Rosehill but found Ertijaaj far too strong in the concluding stages. Should make use of the inside gate and boot up again. Bound to be there for a long way. SCINTILLA (7) is a good fresh performer with sound each-way claims and the very best efforts of BEAU BANDIT (8) measure up well. Two runs this prep have been sound.
